producers.name: Domaine Dureuil-Janthial
producers.village: 10 rue de la Buisserolle, 71150 Rully, France
producers.intro: Janthial 家族的 Rully 渊源可追溯至十三世纪。Céline 与 Vincent Dureuil 于 1994 年承接家族酒庄；Vincent 获得 La Revue du Vin de France 2019 年度 Vigneron。旧文将其定位为 Rully 风土复兴代表；这属于报道评价，不是官方法定等级。
producers.scope: 首版资料；保留原始资料日期及年份范围，逐年份技术资料与图片持续补充。

sections.text: 官网记载约 20 ha，涵盖 Rully、Mercurey、Puligny-Montrachet 与 Nuits-Saint-Georges；其中某些微小地块仅 0.0871 ha。不同地块的老藤栽植年份均按酒款技术单保留。

sections.title: 栽培
sections.text: 强调土壤生命力、有机导向、人工采收、产量管理和地块区分。公开技术单提到不同地块及手工分选；有机证书状态需另外确认，不能单凭报道宣称最新认证。

sections.title: 酿造与熟成
sections.text: 2019 版白葡萄酒技术单：直接压榨、约 48 小时静置澄清、木桶酒精发酵、约 12 个月桶熟和约 6 个月不锈钢熟成；红葡萄酒双重分选、视年份去梗与否、木质截锥形发酵罐、浸渍和桶熟。文件中的新桶比例是历史技术基准而非所有年份恒定数字。

wines.name: Rully Blanc
wines.place: Rully 的 La Martelle、Chaponnière、La Bergerie 与 Le Meix Cadot 多地块；土壤因地块而异; 历史技术单所列栽植年：1949–2007; 历史地块面积：3.3187 ha
wines.method: 人工采收、轻柔直接压榨、48 小时静置澄清；桶中发酵，历史技术单约 20% 新桶；桶熟 12 个月后转不锈钢罐约 6 个月。
wines.detail: 村庄级多地块 Chardonnay：表现成熟果肉感与保留的线性结构；多地块直到装瓶才调配，非一级园酒。
wines.vintageScope: 约 2019 年技术基线；不代表当前年份的固定配方。

en.place: Rully; La Martelle, Chaponnière, La Bergerie and Le Meix Cadot; Multiple parcels; soil variable; Planting years in historical sheet: 1949–2007; Historical parcel area: 3.3187 ha
en.method: Hand-picked and direct-pressed; approx. 48 h settling, barrel fermentation (historic sheet c.20% new oak), approx. 12 months in barrel plus 6 months stainless-steel.
en.detail: Multi-parcel Village Chardonnay; ripe fruit and linear mineral structure, blended only at bottling according to historic sheet.
en.vintageScope: Technical baseline circa 2019; not a fixed specification for current vintages.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Maizières
wines.place: Rully 东侧村庄级地块，邻近 D981，朝东；黏土; 历史技术单所列栽植年：1997–2001; 历史地块面积：1.9993 ha
wines.method: 人工采收、轻柔直接压榨、48 小时静置澄清；桶中发酵，历史技术单约 20% 新桶；桶熟 12 个月后转不锈钢罐约 6 个月。
wines.detail: 东向偏暖黏土地块，熟成果味与相对丰满质地并存，酒庄以较长熟成保留张力。
wines.vintageScope: 约 2019 年技术基线；不代表当前年份的固定配方。

en.place: Village east of Rully, near D981; east aspect; Clay; Planting years in historical sheet: 1997–2001; Historical parcel area: 1.9993 ha
en.method: Hand-picked and direct-pressed; approx. 48 h settling, barrel fermentation (historic sheet c.20% new oak), approx. 12 months in barrel plus 6 months stainless-steel.
en.detail: Sunny east-facing clay parcel; mature-fruit texture and ageing emphasis.
en.vintageScope: Technical baseline circa 2019; not a fixed specification for current vintages.

wines.name: Rully Blanc Chêne
wines.place: Rully 的 Chênes lieu-dit；白色石灰质泥灰岩; 历史技术单所列栽植年：1975; 历史地块面积：1.0147 ha

wines.detail: 白色石灰质泥灰岩，酒庄技术单称酒体更挺直、紧凑且有耐久力。
wines.vintageScope: 约 2019 年技术基线；不代表当前年份的固定配方。

en.method: Hand-picked and direct-pressed; approx. 48 h settling, barrel fermentation (historic sheet c.20% new oak), approx. 12 months in barrel plus 6 months stainless-steel.
en.detail: White calcareous marl; the producer describes a straight, tense, ageworthy style.
en.vintageScope: Technical baseline circa 2019; not a fixed specification for current vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Le Meix Cadot
wines.place: Rully 中部，朝东，较早成熟；黏土石灰质土; 历史技术单所列栽植年：1975; 历史地块面积：1.0147 ha
wines.method: 人工采收、轻柔直接压榨、48 小时静置澄清；桶中发酵，历史技术单约 20% 新桶；桶熟 12 个月后转不锈钢罐约 6 个月。
wines.detail: Le Meix Cadot 的朝东坡位与黏土石灰岩基础塑造精确线性酸度与成熟果实之间的张力；勿与 Vieilles Vignes 独立酒混并。
wines.vintageScope: 约 2019 年技术基线；不代表当前年份的固定配方。

en.place: Central Rully, east-facing and early-ripening; Clay-limestone; Planting years in historical sheet: 1975; Historical parcel area: 1.0147 ha
en.method: Hand-picked and direct-pressed; approx. 48 h settling, barrel fermentation (historic sheet c.20% new oak), approx. 12 months in barrel plus 6 months stainless-steel.
en.detail: East-facing, precocious clay-limestone site; balance ripe fruit against structural precision. Separate label from Vieilles Vignes.
en.vintageScope: Technical baseline circa 2019; not a fixed specification for current vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Le Meix Cadot Vieilles Vignes
wines.place: Rully 中部，朝东；黏土石灰质土; 历史技术单所列栽植年：Pierre Janthial 于 1920 年代栽植; 历史地块面积：0.4411 ha

wines.detail: 独立 Vieilles Vignes 选桶／选园酒；二十世纪二十年代栽植的老藤与较深果肉感、矿物张力相关。
wines.vintageScope: 约 2019 年技术基线；不代表当前年份的固定配方。

en.place: Central Rully; east-facing; Clay-limestone; Planting years in historical sheet: Planted in 1920s by Pierre Janthial; Historical parcel area: 0.4411 ha
en.method: Hand-picked and direct-pressed; approx. 48 h settling, barrel fermentation (historic sheet c.20% new oak), approx. 12 months in barrel plus 6 months stainless-steel.
en.detail: Separate old-vine label, from 1920s plantings attributed to Pierre Janthial; depth and tension distinguish it from standard Le Meix Cadot.
en.vintageScope: Technical baseline circa 2019; not a fixed specification for current vintages.

wines.name: Rully Premier Cru Blanc Margotés
wines.place: Rully 南部，朝东南；白色石灰质泥灰岩; 历史技术单所列栽植年：1946 与 2015; 历史地块面积：0.9024 ha

wines.detail: 南段东南朝向白色石灰质泥灰岩；可呈现清晰香气、紧实矿物口感与良好余味，不可视为 Villaine 同名酒。
wines.vintageScope: 约 2019 年技术基线；不代表当前年份的固定配方。

en.place: Southern Rully, south-east aspect; White limestone marl; Planting years in historical sheet: 1946 and 2015; Historical parcel area: 0.9024 ha

sections.title: History
sections.text: The Ninot family traces viticulture and coopering in Rully to the 14th century. Pierre-Marie rebuilt the inherited estate; Erell returned in 2003 and Flavien joined around 2012/13. Their wines focus on distinct Rully parcels in both colours.

sections.title: Ownership

sections.title: Viticulture

sections.title: History
sections.text: Founded in the 1970s by Michel Briday and continued by Stéphane and Sandrine Briday, with an emphasis on site-dependent harvesting and restrained oak.

sections.title: Ownership
sections.text: Family-operated Briday estate.

sections.title: Vineyards
sections.text: Historic third-party area estimates vary roughly 13.7–15 ha. Rully white Premiers Crus include Grésigny, La Pucelle and Les Cloux; reds Champs Cloux and Les Pierres, plus village Clos de Remenot Monopole.

sections.title: Viticulture
sections.text: Manual harvesting, site-tailored ripeness; 2014 Terra Vitis claim appears in tourism history, but contemporary certification should be checked.

sections.title: Vinification & élevage
sections.text: Whites are direct pressed and fermented with native yeast in 300/400 L barrels or vats by cuvée. Reds may use limited whole clusters, pre-fermentation maceration, indigenous yeast, 20–25-day vinification and oak according to individual label.

sections.text: Family estate established in 1955 by Christophe-Amédée Grandmougin; Christophe-Jean followed in 1991 and Christophe-Andréa continued from around 2021/22.

grapeWines.name: Rully Blanc Les Saint-Jacques
grapeWines.description:
2022: 2021 春霜时本酒与 Les Clous Aimé 混成另一个 Bourgogne Côte Chalonnaise Cuvée Ronde；2022 独立恢复，主要以大型木桶发酵熟成。
2024: 酒庄强调约每株四串葡萄、深厚粉砂壤与 Chardonnay 的平衡；主要在 foudre 与使用三年的桶中酒泥熟成。香气轻盈、口感清脆；建议较年轻饮用。
grapeWines.serving: 白酒起始约 12–14°C；红酒约 14–16°C，具体酒庄建议与年份为准。

intro.en: Northern Côte Chalonnaise village appellation for Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, with 23 Premier Cru climats across Rully and Chagny.
intro.zh: Côte Chalonnaise 北部的村庄级法定产区，以 Chardonnay 白葡萄酒与 Pinot Noir 红葡萄酒为主，包含 Rully、Chagny 两市镇及 23 个一级园 climat。

body.en: Monastic and ducal history; the AOC was granted on 13 June 1939. Rully has also long been a centre for traditional-method sparkling wines, which are labelled under the separate Crémant de Bourgogne AOP.
body.zh: 早期葡萄园与修道院、勃艮第公爵相关。1939 年 6 月 13 日获 AOC；自 19 世纪初也为勃艮第起泡酒中心之一，但 Crémant de Bourgogne 为不同 AOP。

body.en: Northern Côte Chalonnaise in Saône-et-Loire, covering Rully and Chagny; roughly 230–300 m, with meaningful variation in slope, aspect, drainage and elevation.
body.zh: 位于 Saône-et-Loire 的 Côte Chalonnaise 北部。Rully 和 Chagny 两市镇，坡地约 230–300 米，坡向、排水和局地地形变异明显。

body.en: Temperate continental-influenced Burgundy climate, with spring frost, harvest precipitation, mildew pressure and growing heat/vintage variation.
body.zh: 勃艮第温带偏大陆性气候，春霜、成熟季降雨、霉病压力及炎热年份的成熟度管理构成主要风险。

body.en: Limestone, marl, clay-limestone and varying brown soils; avoid one-to-one grape/soil determinism. Premier Cru mesoclimates and soil depth vary.
body.zh: 石灰岩、泥灰岩、黏土石灰质及局部褐色土。不能笼统说全部 Chardonnay 在石灰岩、全部 Pinot 在黏土上；一级园的坡位与土层深度差异显著。

body.en: Still dry whites primarily Chardonnay and reds Pinot Noir. Whites can be floral, citrus/peach-driven and textural; reds show cherries, berries, florals and nuanced tannins. Better Premier Crus have ageability.
body.zh: 静态干白 Chardonnay 为主、静态红 Pinot Noir 为主；白酒典型花香、柠檬与白桃并带矿物及果肉质地；红酒樱桃、红黑浆果、花香、细单宁，优质一级园能长期陈年。

body.en: Village appellation with 23 named Premier Cru climats and no Grand Cru. Rully covers the communes of Rully and Chagny. Still whites are primarily Chardonnay and reds Pinot Noir; Crémant de Bourgogne is a separate appellation.
body.zh: 村庄级产区，含 23 个 Premier Cru climat，无 Grand Cru。范围包括 Rully 与 Chagny；静态白葡萄酒以 Chardonnay 为主，红葡萄酒以 Pinot Noir 为主。Crémant de Bourgogne 为另一法定产区。

body.en: Current numerical production limits and accessory-grape provisions require consultation of the consolidated specification. Historical summaries are not used here as current law.
body.zh: 现行产量、栽植密度及辅助品种等数值条款仍须对照完整现行规范；本页不将历史摘要当作现行法规。
